description:
GAP: OctoPi.Agent.Session is a GenServer (octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/session.ex:26) with start_link/1, but OctoPi.Agent.start_session/1 calls Session.start_link directly (agent.ex:36) without placing the process under a supervisor. Callers in cli.ex:157 and modes/print.ex:43 start sessions as unsupervised processes. In a multi-session world (forking, concurrent agents) this means crashed sessions leave no trace and cannot be enumerated or managed.

WHAT THIS TICKET DOES:

STEP 1 -- Add DynamicSupervisor to OctoPi.Agent.Application:
In apps/octo_pi_agent/lib/octo_pi/agent/application.ex, add:
  {DynamicSupervisor, name: OctoPi.Agent.SessionSupervisor, strategy: :one_for_one}
to the children list alongside the existing LoopSupervisor, ToolSupervisor, and Subscribers.

STEP 2 -- Update OctoPi.Agent.start_session/1:
Change from:
  def start_session(opts), do: Session.start_link(opts)
To:
  def start_session(opts) do
    DynamicSupervisor.start_child(OctoPi.Agent.SessionSupervisor, {Session, opts})
  end
Session must implement a child_spec/1 (use GenServer provides this automatically if start_link/1 is defined with the right signature). Verify Session.start_link/1 signature is compatible with child_spec or add an explicit child_spec/1.

STEP 3 -- Verify callers are unaffected:
cli.ex and modes/print.ex both pattern-match on {:ok, session}. DynamicSupervisor.start_child returns {:ok, pid} on success, so the call sites do not need to change.

STEP 4 -- Session restart strategy:
Use restart: :temporary on the Session child spec (default for DynamicSupervisor children). Sessions should not be automatically restarted on crash -- a crashed session is a terminated conversation, not a transient fault.

RELATIONSHIP TO EXTENSION.MANAGER (opi-fin.3.1):
Once sessions are supervised, each Session (coding agent process) starts Extension.Manager via start_link (linked) as described in opi-fin.3.1. If the Session dies, Extension.Manager and all extension Agents die with it. The SessionSupervisor sees the Session exit but does not restart it (restart: :temporary).

TEST: Verify that two concurrent start_session calls produce two independent supervised children. Verify that a Session crash removes it from the supervisor without restarting. Verify {:ok, pid} return shape is preserved for existing callers.
title: Supervise coding agent sessions under Agent.Supervisor
